independence.method: Independent domain-completion, physical Young-budget, compact inverse/spectral construction and coupled transmission audit

accepted_exact_claim: On sufficiently short restrictions of the same stated Q crossing, the full coupled Hessian extends to a coercive closed form on H1_0 x X_A x H1_0 with compact embedding into the positive kinetic space. The supplied inverse and spectral construction yields a positive self-adjoint linear operator and unique finite-energy weak linear waves. Its exact domain is u inV withh,P inH1 andeta inH2; it admits the fluid-compensated nonzero-center-flux example withpsi notH1.

full coupled Young budget and physical dimensions

spectral exhaustion and diagonal operator/form domains
strong operator factors and exact domain equivalence
center transmission without forced zero flux

explicit_reconstructions: Spectral exhaustion: any remaining unit vector with positive Rayleigh value would lower-bound every subsequent maximizing eigenvalue, contradicting their convergence tozero.
Wave partial sums converge uniformly in time by invariant tail energy.
The weighted integration-by-parts pairing usesbounded H1 flux andAC test withL1 derivative.
